description: Push and in-app notification system with preferences management.

screens_added.name: Notification Settings
screens_added.purpose: Toggle per notification type and delivery channel

flows_added: Event triggers notification → push sent → user taps → deep links to relevant screen
User opens notification settings → toggles types → selects channels (push/email/SMS)
interaction_patterns: Push notification tap deep links directly to the relevant screen — never to notification list
Unread dot on notification icon — disappears on open
Notification categories — activity, updates, promotions — separately toggleable
Notification permission prompt — shown after first meaningful action, never on launch

error_flows.trigger: Push notification permission denied by user
error_flows.ui: No prompt re-shown for 30 days after denial. In-app notification centre still works fully. Settings screen shows 'Enable push notifications' card with direct link to device settings. Never nag.

error_flows.trigger: Notification deep link points to deleted content
error_flows.ui: Navigate to parent screen instead of crashing. Show toast: 'This content is no longer available'. Never show blank screen or error code. Example: notification for deleted post → open feed.
In-app notification centre always shows all notifications regardless of push delivery status. Badge count reflects unread in-app count, not push delivery count.

error_flows.trigger: Batch of notifications arrives after long offline period
error_flows.ui: Group notifications by type — do not flood notification centre. Show: 'You have 12 new activity notifications' as single grouped item. Expand to see all. Never send 12 individual pushes on reconnect.

error_flows.trigger: Notification settings sync fails across devices
error_flows.ui: Settings saved locally first, synced to server. If sync fails: local preference honoured. Show sync error badge in settings. Retry on next app open. Never lose user preference.

edge_cases.case: User has notifications enabled but device is in Do Not Disturb
edge_cases.ui: No special handling needed — OS handles DND. Never override OS-level DND for non-critical notifications. Only critical alerts (transaction failures, security alerts) may use high-priority channel.

edge_cases.case: Notification for content the user has already seen
edge_cases.ui: Mark notification as read automatically if user has already viewed the linked content. Badge count decrements. Never show notification as unread for already-seen content.

edge_cases.case: User taps notification while already on the linked screen
edge_cases.ui: Refresh the current screen content instead of re-navigating. No animation flash or stutter. Subtle refresh indicator only.

edge_cases.case: Notification settings differ between web and mobile
edge_cases.ui: Show separate toggles for each platform in notification settings. Changes to one do not affect the other. Clear labels: 'Mobile push' vs 'Email' vs 'In-app'.

edge_cases.case: Notification for action completed by a different device
edge_cases.ui: Still show notification if it carries new information (e.g. order shipped). Suppress notification if it is purely confirmatory of an action the user just took on this device (e.g. 'login successful' after login).
